author: elketro
quote: GTA6 was a letdown. Jason is honestly so boring, no personality whatsoever, just a yesman to Lucia which is totally unlikable, she never does anything for Jason, it’s only one way street. I didn’t care what happened to any of the characters. Best part of the whole game is Nico Bellic cameo, still a total badass, wish I could play as him again.
